text:
Ingrid: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands about process (release cadence, oncall, quality bars, SLAs). Dropping the decisions and action items here.

Lee: Thanks! First: confirm cadence?

Ingrid: Biweekly release train (Tue 09:00 PT) for majors, weekly Thu for infra patches, hotfixes ad-hoc via rollback playbook. Feature work should use feature flags where feasible.

Matt: Freeze window for runtime/model-serving changes?

Ingrid: 48h freeze prior to deploy for runtime or serving changes. UI-only can be gated behind flags.

Sofia: Oncall: 2-week rotations, primary + secondary. Escalation: primary -> secondary -> oncall manager (20m) -> SRE lead. Targets: acknowledge <10m, mitigation/rollback attempt <30m. Notify CS within 1h if hosted SLA affected.

Lee: Are Dedicated enterprise customers on the same internal pager SLO?

Sofia: Default internal pager SLO is 10m. Enterprise/Dedicated SLAs can specify different ack/response windows in the SOW.

Emily: Canary windows and rollback criteria?

Priya: Starting defaults: 5% for 1h, then 25% for 6h, then 100% if green. Monitor model-quality evals, token-error rate, user error-rate, latency p95/p99. Auto-rollback triggers: quality regression >5% on labeled evals, user error-rate >2x baseline, p99 latency +40% (or p95 +200ms) over baseline. ML will tune per-model.

Lee: Where are the playbooks and runbooks?

deploy-bot: Release playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/release-cadence  Canary policy: https://redwood.internal/platform/canary-policy  Incident runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/incident-response

Matt: Sales asked about SLA credits for hosted API downtime. Public page?

Ingrid: Public-facing SLA summary exists (hosted: 99.9% monthly uptime). Credits are pro-rata after incident classification. Dedicated/private terms in SOWs. Internal sales doc: https://redwood.internal/sla-summary

Emily: Who owns evals and prompt sets for regression detection?

Priya: Shared ownership: Research manages the harness and metrics, Product owns prompt sets & acceptance criteria, Eng+SRE own rollout automation. We'll add a RACI to the playbook.

Lee: Can oncall rollback without PM approval during incidents?

Ingrid: Yes. Oncall has rollback authority for incidents meeting severity thresholds in the runbook. Notify PMs ASAP but do not block rollback.

Ingrid: Action items: Priya update canary numbers & RACI by Friday EOD; Sofia post oncall rota template after office hours; we'll run a 45-min office hours Wed 4pm PT to walk the playbook. Tag me if I missed anything.
